model.name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
model.capture: 8 sentences, 176 activation rows, forward hooks on all 36 organs of all 6 layers

correction_first.what_the_last_receipt_could_be_read_as: that the campaign's acceptance gate is weight-space
correction_first.the_fact: accept_pack's representation gate is ALREADY OUTPUT-SPACE -- it compares w_true @ x against a matvec of the packed bytes. Every number in the previous receipt stands, because it measured gravity_native.fidelity(), which IS weight-space. But the finding MOVES rather than vanishing: a single GAUSSIAN x is exactly the directionless input that receipt showed to be blind, so the live question is WHICH x AND HOW MANY.
correction_first.found_by: wiring the new function into accept_pack and reading its body

the_two_gates_disagree_on_1_in_18.honesty_about_the_false_positive: it is a NEAR-THRESHOLD case: 0.99273 against a 0.99 bar in weight space, 0.98974 in output space. A boundary disagreement, not a blowout, and it is reported as one.
the_two_gates_disagree_on_1_in_18.the_false_negatives_are_systematic: 5 of 6 layers' output.dense at 3 bits. The sixth, layer 3, is refused by BOTH gates at 0.9838 -- so the pattern is a property of that organ and not a scatter.

the_mechanism_quantified_over_108_packs.reading: feeding DIRECTIONLESS inputs through the pack reproduces the weight-space cosine to a mean of 0.000535 across all 108 packs, while real inputs differ by 0.0253 -- 47x. That is not an analogy: the weight-space number IS the directionless-input number, measured.

what_it_would_be_worth.over: 35 of 36 organs where both gates resolve inside 2-4 bits
what_it_would_be_worth.not_a_recommendation: 6.63% on ONE small encoder at ONE group size, judged by a one-layer output cosine. It sizes the disagreement; it does not authorise packing anything at 3 bits.

SAMPLE_SIZE_BEATS_REALISM_AND_THAT_WAS_N.surprise: ONE REAL ROW IS WORSE THAN ONE GAUSSIAN VECTOR -- 83.3% against 91.7% agreement with the full capture. A single token is high-variance; a Gaussian averages over directions. The obvious fix, 'just use a real activation', is REFUTED at N=1, and the mean cosine gaps are within 0.0002 of each other (0.0066 vs 0.0068).
SAMPLE_SIZE_BEATS_REALISM_AND_THAT_WAS_N.the_rule: a ONE-ROW gate flips its verdict on 12.6% of packs; 8 rows gets it to 8.9%, 32 rows to 3.1%, 64 rows to 0.7%. SAMPLE SIZE FIRST, REALISM SECOND -- and this is the same disease as the undersampled-fit finding sealed earlier in this program, arriving from the other direction.

shipped.gravity_native.output_space_fidelity: carries the sample-size rule in its docstring
shipped.accept_pack(activations=...): reports the wider reading BESIDE the verdict and never as the verdict, so a caller without activations cannot silently get a weaker answer

claim_boundary.one_model: MiniLM, 6 layers, 36 organs. A small bidirectional encoder is not a decoder and not an MoE.
claim_boundary.176_rows_is_the_ceiling_here: the convergence curve is measured AGAINST the full capture, not against truth -- it shows how fast a subsample approaches 176 rows, and says nothing about whether 176 rows is enough
claim_boundary.still_a_proxy: one layer's output cosine is not coherence; composition is untested
claim_boundary.the_lake_sweep_is_still_running: four specimens, I/O starved at 0.22-0.42 MB/s behind an unrelated filler; not claimed

AMENDED_IN_PLACE_2026_08_25.what_is_corrected: this receipt justified weight-space grading with 'no runtime here executes a Qwen3-MoE, Falcon or Mamba forward pass'. THAT CONFLATES TWO RUNTIMES. Hawking's Rust body dispatches only on llama/mistral/qwen2 families and really does cover none of them; mlx_lm 0.31.3 -- already a hard dependency and the runtime every AIR kernel executes through -- carries model classes for qwen3_moe, qwen3_vl_moe, kimi_vl AND falcon_h1.
AMENDED_IN_PLACE_2026_08_25.what_the_gate_actually_is: FAST LOCAL STORAGE. Falcon-H1-7B, the smallest specimen, is 15.17 GB and under the operator-prioritised fill a sequential read did not complete 256 MiB in 120 s -- under ~0.5 MB/s against 96-131 MiB/s uncontended.
AMENDED_IN_PLACE_2026_08_25.what_does_NOT_change: every weight-space caveat here stands. No forward pass was run and no activations exist for any lake specimen; what changes is the REMEDIATION -- a quiesced window rather than writing a reader.
